title: Count and Compare · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Count and Compare · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Draw two separate groups containing different numbers of dots, no more than six in each group. The lead counts both groups and identifies which has more. Both counts and the comparison match the drawing. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Count and Compare, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
Both counts and the comparison match the drawing.
recall.why: Both counts and the comparison match the drawing.
